Do you have a strong commercial mindset and a keen interest in category management? Do you want to be part of a successful international company where purchasing plays a key strategic role in our continued grwoth?

Then you might be the colleague we are looking for.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you will join a dedicated and experienced Purchasing department, where your ideas, performance and growth ambitions are truly valued.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• The opportunity to apply your background and develop your purchasing skills with a clear development path towards a future Category Manager role

• Involvement in the entire purchasing process, including supplier visits, market monitoring, negotiations, quality assurance and pricing

• Development and training in category management

• A skilled and experienced team of colleagues that appreciates results and initiative

• An informal workplace where we live by the values: “Colleague, Coporate spirit and the right and duty to speak up"

• The opportunity to build your skills and a career at JYSK

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Category Buyer, your role will centre around supporting the ongoing development of our categories within Home textiles across more than 30 countries. You will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers, contributing to strategic purchasing activities and product performance.

You can expect approximately 20 travel days per year.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Developing and optimising product assortments

• Monitoring and analysing product performance and preparing reports

• Collaborating with suppliers, colleagues, and cross-functional teams

• Supporting ongoing improvement in quality, functionality and commercial appeal

This position is designed for someone with the drive and potential to grow into a future Category Manager role.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a relevant degree at Bachelor’s or Master’s level

• Some years of experience as a buyer and strong interest in purchasing, product design, quality and functionality

• Solid Excel skills and confidence working with IT systems, with openness to learning new tools

• A structured, analytical mindset and ease working with numbers and data

• High attention to detail and the ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment

• Strong stakeholder management and relationship‑building skills

• Clear and effective communication in Danish and English, both spoken and written

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Category Manager, Katrine Veggerby at +45 2174 2074.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will:

• Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing.

• Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level.

• Balance active coding (C#, Angular, APL) with guiding automation initiatives

• Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team.

• Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs.

• Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills.

• Represent QA/Dev combined approach in cross-team forums.

• Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions

• Advocate for and implement improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes.

• Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality

• Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange.

**What We Value

**

• We are looking for an engineer who has demonstrated leadership abilities

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with combined Dev/QA responsibilities.

• Expertise in .NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.

• Known for impactful leadership, resulting in improved efficiency and project success among engineering teams

• Extensive background in test automation (E2E, API, Integration) and test strategy

• Solid experience in architecting and developing enterprise-scale applications.

• Extensive knowledge of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures (Microsoft Azure experience)

• Deep expertise in CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).

• Thorough understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and Domain-Driven Design

• Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, continuous integration).

• Experience with relational databases (SQL).

• Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.

• Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), both written and spoken

• Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.

• Background in FinTech or capital markets.

• Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process.

To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong interest in building AI-first products who enjoys owning problems end-to-end – from vague client needs and early hypotheses to production-grade systems that actually get used.

**What You’ll Do

**You’ll join The Tech Collective (our Data & AI hub, specifically), where we help organisations design, build, and operationalise data- and AI-driven solutions.

This role is tailor-made for a systems thinker and builder – someone who has shipped real products, taken responsibility for technical direction, and is motivated by creating pragmatic solutions that combine data, software, and AI.

You’ll work closely with experienced AI specialists who bring deep model and ML expertise, while you focus on building robust products and software around those capabilities.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• End-to-end solution ownership: designing and implementing full-stack applications from early concepts and prototypes to scalable, production-grade systems, including architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud

• Modern full-stack development: building high-quality frontend and backend services, applying sound software engineering principles, and using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and critically

• AI-enabled product building: collaborating with AI specialists to integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and agentic patterns into real products, and translating AI potential into solutions that make sense for organisations

• Data and systems thinking: designing data models, reasoning about distributed systems and trade-offs, and implementing event-driven or real-time features where they add value

• Observability and evaluation: experience setting up the right observability and eval tooling to establish traceability and iteratively improve on products

• Cloud, delivery, and collaboration: deploying and operating solutions in cloud environments, balancing speed, robustness, and security, and working closely with clients and stakeholders to create tangible business impact

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re looking for someone with an AI builder mentality and 5+ years of hands-on full-stack experience, who is comfortable owning applications end to end – from frontend and backend to data and deployment.

You don’t need to tick every box, but you should recognise yourself in most of the following:

• Strong full-stack foundation: solid skills in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building and shipping production systems

• Mentoring experience: helping other developers through technical sparring and code reviews

• Outward curiosity: actively seeking to understand client problems in detail and working in close collaboration with them to solve them

• Ownership and leadership: a track record of building substantial solutions from scratch (e.g., startup, scale-up, or personal ventures), taking responsibility for outcomes, and leading technical direction without relying on formal authority

• System-level thinking: the ability to reason about architecture, data flows, trade-offs, and failure modes across the stack, and to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous contexts

• Critical technical judgement: a keen eye for identifying weaknesses in existing architectures and tech stacks, and knowing where and how to improve them

• Communication and collaboration: the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, work across disciplines, and learn from – and share knowledge with – others in the team and across Implement

• Tool agnostic: capable of choosing the right tool for the job

**What We Offer

**We offer a role with technical ownership and influence, working in a 20-person team that feels much closer to a nerdy startup than a large corporation – while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group.

You’ll gain exposure to a wide range of data- and AI-driven problems across industries, all within a culture built on trust, curiosity, humility, resilience, and impact. You’ll also have great freedom to shape your own role, deepen your expertise, and grow in exactly the direction that motivates you.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Apply ASAP.

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

We’re expanding our team and look forward to meeting talented people who are curious about a career in information systems and management consulting at the intersection of business and technology.

**AI Agent Engineer

**Department: AI Delivery

Location: Copenhagen

Working model: Onsite

Reports to: AI Product Lead

Salary: Competitive

**About Autoflows

**Autoflows is an agentic after-sales platform for automotive retail.

We deploy AI agents across dealerships in Europe that handle customer conversations end to end across voice and messaging. Our agents identify the right moment to contact customers about service, MOT, warranty and other after-sales opportunities, then handle the conversation, book the appointment and write the outcome back into the dealership's systems.

Our platform connects with DMS, CRM and OEM data, turning after-sales work that traditionally sits in queues into work that runs itself.

We are now scaling across clients, markets and languages. That requires us to build a delivery capability that does not depend on one person knowing how everything works.

**The Role

**As an AI Agent Engineer, you will build, deploy, debug and continuously improve the conversational agents running across our clients.

**You Will Work Across The Full Lifecycle

****Build → Test → Deploy → Monitor → Debug → Improve

**You will start closely with the AI Product Lead and progressively take independent ownership of production agents and client implementations.

The role is not just about configuring agents. With time you will also help build the tooling and systems that make agents easier to deploy, operate and maintain at scale. Architectural decisions for the core agentic platform stay with the AI Product Lead; your platform involvement is about the tooling layer around agents, not the underlying architecture itself.

**What You'll Do

****Agent development

**

• Build and tune agents across voice, chat, SMS and WhatsApp

• Develop prompts, tools, workflows, guardrails and fallback paths

• Test agents against realistic customer scenarios

• Improve agent behavior using production data and conversation analysis

**Production & implementation

**

• Diagnose and fix live issues such as model failures, mispronunciations, failed tool calls, broken workflows and missing fallback paths

• Own new agent deployments as dealership clients onboard

• Adapt agents to different processes, languages and markets

• Work directly with clients when technical input is required

• Identify root causes rather than applying temporary fixes

**Integrations

**

• Work with DMS, CRM and other dealership systems

• Configure and troubleshoot integrations for customer data and workshop bookings

• Build reusable patterns for recurring integration requirements

**Agentic platform tooling

**

• We are building an agentic platform, not a collection of manually maintained bots. You will be encouraged to identify repetitive work and turn it into systems. This may include:

• Automated testing and evaluation

• Monitoring and regression detection

• Automated diagnosis of recurring failures

• Self-healing or automated recovery for well-understood failure modes

• Automated deployment and configuration

• Reusable agent components and workflows

• Agent-assisted documentation and operational tooling

• Systems that allow agents to improve from production feedback within defined quality and safety boundaries

**| "The principle is simple: if we solve the same problem repeatedly, we should build a system that solves it for us."

****Architecture & delivery

**

• Work with the AI Product Lead on complex architectural decisions

• Help determine when to use prompting, workflow logic, deterministic code, specialised agents or other approaches

• Document recurring solutions and contribute to the team's technical playbook

• Help establish standards that make future deployments faster and more reliable

**What We're Looking For

**This role sits between AI, technology and human behaviour. Technical ability is necessary, but technical ability alone is not enough. Our agents speak to real customers. You need to care about what the interaction feels like, not just whether the system technically works.

**Technical

**

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI APIs

• Strong understanding of prompting and model behaviour

• Experience debugging AI or software systems

• Ability to reason through ambiguous technical problems

• Comfort working without a finished specification

• Ability to learn unfamiliar platforms and systems quickly

**Human & social

**

• Strong social skills and clear communication

• Natural curiosity about how people think, speak and respond

• Ability to look at an interaction from the customer's perspective

• Good judgement about tone, context and conversational nuance

• Comfortable speaking directly with clients and asking the questions needed to understand a problem

• Able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people

• Open to feedback and willing to change your approach when evidence shows it is not working

• Interested in how language and culture affect conversational AI

**Builder mindset

**

• You investigate why something failed rather than simply fixing the visible symptom

• You notice repetitive work and look for ways to automate it

• You are comfortable experimenting, testing and iterating

• You think beyond the individual agent and look for ways to improve the underlying platform

**Strong plus

**

• Conversational AI or agent-building experience

• Voice AI, chatbots or workflow automation

• API and systems integration experience

• Experience with tools, function calling or agentic workflows

• Experience operating production AI systems

• Experience working across multiple languages

• Experience with CRM, ERP, DMS or similar business systems

• Automotive experience is not required.

**| "We would rather hire a technically capable builder who understands people than a technically exceptional engineer who does not."

****Success in the Role

**As you become fully productive, you should be able to:

• Independently diagnose and resolve most common agent failures

• Build and deploy agents with limited supervision

• Own production improvements from investigation through deployment

• Handle recurring integration problems

• Turn repeated manual work into reusable systems

• Improve the reliability and scalability of our agent platform

• Reduce the amount of hands-on implementation required from the AI Product Lead

**The Team

****You Will Work In a Small AI Delivery Team

**AI Product Lead - Owns product direction, architecture, priorities, technical standards and complex technical decisions

AI Agent Engineer - Owns agent development, implementation, production debugging and platform improvements

AI/ML Student - Supports testing, evaluation, research, data work, experimentation and implementation

Because the team is small, you will have significant ownership and direct exposure to the systems we are building.

**How To Apply

**Send your CV along with:

Show us something you built, broke or fixed. A link, repository, write-up, video or before/after example. We care more about how you approached the problem than how polished the result is.

Tell us why this problem interests you. Give us a short note explaining what attracts you to conversational AI, agentic systems and the challenge of making them work reliably in the real world.

Contact: Maz Katinas, AI Product Lead

**Job Description

****Would you like to make testing exciting? Are you passionate about shaping the way we work with software testing? Would you like to embark on a journey where we elevate our professional software testing standards to the next level?

**If so, we would be delighted to welcome you to BEUMER Group Software Solutions, a global family-owned company.

**Play a Central Role

**Every year, millions of passengers check in their baggage at one airport and collect it at another. This seamless experience relies on the quality of BEUMER Group software powering our complex baggage handling systems around the world. The same high standards of capacity and quality are reflected in our logistics solutions, where distribution centers sort and distribute thousands of parcels every day, quickly and efficiently across the globe.

**From Theory to Practice

**We are passionate about making tomorrow's world a little better, and we believe that high quality is achieved through mature, agile, and well-functioning processes.

Based on recognized testing principles, we have established a solid test process framework and are now fully engaged in implementing it across the organization. Therefore, we are looking for a Software Test Manager who can bridge the gap between theory and practice.

You will be a key player in ensuring that our processes are translated into concrete practices and implemented with a strong focus on delivering real value to both product teams and the System Test function for which we are responsible. In this role, you will act as a coach in our products' transformation journey while actively contributing to the establishment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our System Test suite, with a particular focus on automation.

We expect you to be hands-on and capable of stepping into the role of Test Manager within our software department, supporting teams in testing practices and demonstrating how effective testing contributes to the quality of our software products.

As we continue to gain experience, there will be an ongoing need to innovate and optimize our test process framework, including the adoption and use of AI. In other words, you will have ample opportunities to leverage your experience and expertise.

**What We Offer

**

• A collaborative culture built on trust, respect, and continuous improvement.

• An international work environment with colleagues and customers across the globe.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• Flexible working conditions and a healthy work-life balance.

• An informal and supportive working environment.

• The opportunity to influence quality practices across products and customer projects.

**Your New Team

**You will become part of a Software Test team that supports software product and project teams in testing practices and ensures that testing activities contribute to the quality of our software products and projects. Our team collaborates with a wide range of stakeholders across the organization.

**How You Will Spend Your Time

**As a Software Test Manager, you will primarily work with product development. For new system features, you will gradually take on a Test Architect role by participating in the early clarification and requirements phases.

For these features, you will also serve as the liaison to our highly skilled test team in Poland, which specializes in test automation.

Together with our other Test Manager, you will play a key role in planning and following up on the testing of our regular System Releases. You will also participate, to a limited extent, in manual exploratory testing and engage in discussions with development teams regarding identified defects.

More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

• Implementing the software testing strategy and define strong acceptance criteria.

• Participating in the early requirements clarification phase for new system features and providing test architecture expertise.

• Establishing software test management plans and follow-up activities for System Test initiatives.

• Planning, coordinating, and following up on software System Test activities.

• Contributing to the continuous improvement of our System Test suite and processes.

• Establishing direction and driving the optimization and maturity of our testing processes.

• Strengthening and advancing the software testing discipline within the organization.

**What We Expect From You

**We expect you to have a background as an experienced Test Manager with strong personal impact and excellent communication skills. We also expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related field.

• Have an ISTQB Test Manager certification.

• Possess solid knowledge of software testing methodologies and quality management principles, applying a risk-based approach.

• Have experience with test management tools and defect tracking systems.

• Demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Thrive in a project-driven and technically complex environment.

• Take a structured, analytical, and proactive approach to your work.

• Are fluent in both Danish and English.

Interested?

If you are ready for a new test management challenge where you will take full ownership of deploying testing activities from theory to practice, we encourage you to apply.

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact **Global Head of Software Test Bert Petersen at 5371 1471.

**If you would like to play a committed role in our successful family-owned business, please apply online via the application link.

We look forward to meeting you.

**BEUMER Group

**_Conveying, loading, palletizing, packaging, sortation, and distribution: BEUMER Group is a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-tech intralogistics systems. Our employees stand out through their ability to deliver innovative solutions for our customers. They achieve this through deep industry knowledge and a passion for continuous learning and development.

_We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect, and a culture of trust that fosters stability and security for all employees. Our shared goal is to deliver outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Embedded Software Development and Wireless Technology
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how wireless communication systems power the smart technologies of tomorrow? Do you want to explore embedded software development on a Linux platform? Would you like to join an interdisciplinary R&D team where learning, collaboration, and innovation go hand in hand?

Here is what the job entails

During your internship, you will be part of our concentrator team, where we develop infrastructure products for collecting smart meter data. Your focus will be on embedded development for our Linux platform inside the concentrators, as well as contributing to our solution for automated monitoring the concentrators in operation at our customers.

You will be working with one or more of the following areas during the internship:

• Embedded software development in C++

• Linux platforms

• Statistical data analysis

• Data analysis and visualisation in Python

• Platforms for dashboarding, like Grafana or similar

• Performance analysis of wireless systems

You will gain experience with all phases of a typical development project at Kamstrup – from idea and evaluation to design and prototype implementation. This will give you valuable insight into the diverse and exciting role of a development engineer and help strengthen your future career. The specific content of the internship will be planned together according to your ambitions and competences. It is also possible to work with the topic described above as a semester project or M.Sc. thesis of 6–12 months duration.

Meet your future team

As Intern in our R&D department within wireless communication for smart metering, you will be an integral part of the interdisciplinary team, collaborating with engineers on various development tasks. Together we work to ensure that the data transmissions from smart meters are received and made available to our customers. You will become part of a strong work environment where you will experience a focus on freedom with responsibility and personal development.

Did you know? In addition to Linux experts the team has a homebrewer of beer, a pizza chef and a university lecturer. Moreover, every half year we break out from the development projects and embark on a one-week hackathon, where the entire team collaborates on small proof-of-concept projects.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who can contribute to the R&D department with their updated theoretical knowledge.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

• Are pursuing a relevant engineering degree (e.g., Electrical Engineering or Information and Communication Technology) with an interest in mathematics, communication theory, and software development.

• Have a curious, thorough, and structured approach to solving complex challenges.

• Work independently with attention to detail and a strong desire to learn.

• Value collaboration and strive for continuous professional and personal growth.

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish will be an asset, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions to the internship position, please contact Manager, Rasmus Krigslund, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight
jobs.description:
Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight

What if your operational experience could shape the data and AI capabilities behind better decisions in the battlefield? Join SitaWare Insight as Product Manager, and turn real-world defence and intelligence needs into product features, compelling customer demonstrations and meaningful improvements for soldiers, staff officers and NATO customers.

The job

As Product Manager for SitaWare Insight, you will work alongside our Business Product Manager and development teams to turn operational needs into concrete product features. You will be the voice of the customer and end-user, guiding the team’s day-to-day work and helping us to show what our data and AI platform can do for command and control (C2).

In short, you can look forward to:

• guiding the development team’s day-to-day work, translating operational requirements into concrete features for SitaWare Insight

• representing the voice of the customer and end-user, including prioritising fixes and change requests through our change control boards

• using Insight’s own toolset – dashboards, data import and agents – to build examples that show customers and colleagues what is possible

• supporting the sales team with product expertise, customer visits and proposal input while helping the marketing department to create product collateral

• representing Systematic at conferences, trade shows and user forums, and presenting to customers on-site

The position requires regular international travel to customers and Systematic offices, approximately 20–30 days each year.

Joining the team

Based in Copenhagen, you will be close to the development teams building SitaWare Insight, while collaborating closely with Product Management colleagues in Aarhus. Alongside our Business Product Manager, who owns the product roadmap, you will provide operational input for the team’s daily implementation and help keep development aligned with user needs and product priorities. Together, you will be part of a collaborative team committed to turning data and AI into solutions that make a tangible difference across the defence sector from staff at headquarters to decision-makers in the field.

Your qualifications

You bring a solid background from the armed forces or intelligence services – for example as an officer, NCO or in a role such as an information manager – or several years of hands-on experience working directly with defence or intelligence customers as a supplier of data or information products or systems. This operational experience is essential, as it enables you to understand the realities our end-users face and to translate their needs into concrete product decisions.

We are also looking for:

• a genuine interest in how data and AI support C2, and the ability to translate this into product direction. You do not need to be able to write code, but you must be able to engage confidently in technical dialogue with data engineers and architects

• excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate confidently and effectively in English

• confidence in presenting to larger audiences, for example at customer visits, conferences or user forums

• an independent, structured work style with the ability to prioritise your own work and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you are not just getting a desk at one of the city’s best locations – you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering ensures you are always well taken care of. And whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,200 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today.

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Hans Jørgen Bohlbro, Vice President, Product Management.

jobs.occupation: FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Do you know your way around a balance sheet and a liquidity forecast, and not just the P&L? We are looking for an FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro, Denmark. Based at our headquarters, you will be part of a team of three that provides financial planning, forecasting and analysis across the entire organisation. Strategic Finance is a small function within the CFO area, operating at group level in close collaboration with Group Finance and the business. We do not sit in project or asset controlling.

Your role

You will join a team of three in Strategic Finance. Modelling takes up the largest share of the week, closely followed by understanding how projects, assets and operations flow into the numbers. Collecting, reconciling and reviewing data, and turning it all into analysis, make up the rest.

This is a newly created position, as we are growing the team to match the scope ahead. There is no finished set of models to take over. You will help build them.

With Blackstone Infrastructure set to become a co-owner of Eurowind Energy, Strategic Finance expects to play a growing part in the financial planning and reporting that goes to our owners. Over time, you will work directly with reporting and analysis prepared for one of the world's largest infrastructure investors.

• Budgeting, forecasting and long term financial planning, with an emphasis on balance sheet modelling and liquidity forecasting

• Designing, building and developing integrated financial models (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) at group, portfolio and project level

• Scenario and sensitivity analysis on liquidity, financing and portfolio development

• Monthly and quarterly management reporting and variance analysis

• Preparing presentations for the board and senior management

• Building and maintaining data pipelines and reconciliations between our ERP and our models

• Developing new reporting tools and dashboards, e.g. in Power BI, and shaping the processes behind them

You will also work with department heads and regional leads when the analysis calls for it, but business partnering is not the main focus. The core of the role is the modelling, the data and the analysis that sit behind the decisions.

What we offer

Strategic Finance sits close to the centre of the organisation, and the models built here are used for real decisions.

• Real influence on how our financial models and processes are built. Not just maintaining what exists, but shaping the structure, logic and methods behind them

• A say in how work is organised, from data flows to reporting cadence, in a team that is still taking shape

• Data from across the entire organisation, from development and construction to operations and offtake

• Room to improve how data flows into planning, reporting and analysis

• Close sparring, clear priorities and colleagues who are involved in the work

• Direct exposure to senior management and, over time, to owner level reporting

Required competencies and skills

We are looking for someone with 1 to 5 years of relevant experience. Whether you join as Analyst or Senior Analyst depends on your experience and how the match feels on both sides. The scope and the team are the same.

• A degree in finance, economics, business or a related field

• Experience in FP&A, controlling, consulting or a similar analytical role

• Solid understanding of balance sheet dynamics and liquidity forecasting

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

• Experience working with data from ERP systems

• Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools

• Curiosity about how the business works. You want to understand what drives the numbers, not just report them

• Structured and precise, comfortable with deadlines and shifting priorities

• Knowledge of the energy sector is an advantage

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV and a brief cover letter as soon as possible. In the letter, tell us who you are and, in a few concrete examples, what you have actually delivered in your career so far, such as models you have built, processes you have improved or analyses that changed a decision.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Jeppe Falk Hansen, Lead Specialist, Strategic Finance & Insights, at jfh@ewe.dk.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis

Read more about Eurowind Energy on our website or LinkedIn

As soon as possible

Our goal is to ensure high availability and safe operations, enabling us to accelerate the transition to a fossil-free society together.

As a Control Centre Operator, you will be a key person in the operation of our wind assets.

You will be responsible for:

• Has good IT skills and can navigate digital systems confidently

You will play a vital role within interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues; our ‘Ask and Share’ concept is embedded in the way we work. We also offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

For more information about the position, please contact Martin Jul Tromborg on +45 27875466.

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Recruiter Jette Ingeberg on +45 22 57 07 51

Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.
